methodologyNotes: Prices fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Stripe Billing pricing page geo-routes to localized (EUR/GBP/AUD) pages regardless of locale parameter; USD prices are not published at stripe.com/billing/pricing — only the 0.7% pay-as-you-go rate is currency-agnostic. The monthly subscription tiers (€500–€4,900/month) are EUR-only; those plans are recorded as null monthlyUsd with notes. Chargebee Performance plan is $7,188/year (annual commitment, billed monthly = $599/mo equivalent); confirmed via official site and SoftwareAdvice corroboration. Maxio Grow plan lists at $599 but sources disagree on frequency (official site renders /month; GetApp and Capterra list /year) — recorded as null monthlyUsd with a note rather than asserting a contested figure. Billsby Core=$45/month and Pro=$135/month confirmed via official site; GetApp discrepancy ($35) treated as stale. Zuora pricing is fully quote-only with no published tiers. HIPAA/BAA status set to null where not explicitly stated on security pages.

vendors.name: Chargebee
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.chargebee.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Performance plan confirmed as $7,188/year (annual commitment, billed monthly) = $599/month equivalent. Corroborated by SoftwareAdvice profile.

plans.name: Billing Starter
plans.notes: Free for first $250K cumulative billing; 0.75% overage on billing thereafter. Includes checkout, self-serve portal, 35+ payment gateways.

plans.name: Billing Performance
plans.notes: $7,188/year billed monthly (annual commitment). Covers up to $100K monthly billing volume. Includes advance/consolidated invoices, smart dunning, migration support, engineering consultation.

plans.name: Billing Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Includes multi-entity support, account hierarchy, on-demand discounting, contract terms.

vendors.name: Recurly
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://recurly.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Starter $249/month confirmed. Engage and RevRec starting prices confirmed as annual commitments.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $249/month plus 0.9% of billing volume. First $40K in monthly billings included at no charge. Includes automated global subscription billing, 10+ payment methods, 20+ payment gateways, 1 dunning campaign.

plans.name: All-Access
plans.notes: Quote-only. As low as <1% of billing volume, billed annually. Requires minimum $1M billing volume. Includes AI-powered analytics, multiple dunning campaigns, payments orchestration, multicurrency, SSO.

plans.name: Engage
plans.notes: Starting at $1,600/month billed annually. AI-powered churn propensity modeling, personalized offers, cancel-save and upsell, A/B testing. Price scales with prompt volume and capability needs.

plans.name: RevRec
plans.notes: Starting at $850/month billed annually. Automated revenue recognition, SSP automation, rules-driven allocations, multi-GAAP compliance, immutable audit trail. Price scales with billing volume.

vendors.name: Stripe Billing
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://stripe.com/billing/pricing fetched 2026-06-14, but geo-routes to German/EUR pricing only — USD prices not published at this URL. Pay-as-you-go rate (0.7% of billing volume) is currency-agnostic and confirmed. Monthly subscription tiers shown in EUR (€500–€4,900/month on annual contracts) with no USD equivalent published by Stripe. Those tiers recorded as null. UK page (stripe.com/en-gb/billing/pricing) and AU page (stripe.com/en-au/billing/pricing) corroborate the pay-as-you-go 0.7% rate and tiered subscription model structure.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.notes: No recurring fee. 0.7% of billing volume processed through Stripe Billing. Excludes one-time invoices. Supports recurring billing, usage-based metering (100M events/month), smart retries, customer portal.

plans.name: Monthly subscription — Tier 1
plans.notes: Annual contract, paid monthly. Official pricing page geo-routes to EUR only (€500/month for up to €80,000 billing volume, saves 11% vs pay-as-you-go). USD price not published by Stripe. 0.67% for additional volume beyond tier cap.

plans.name: Monthly subscription — Tier 2
plans.notes: Annual contract, paid monthly. EUR page: €1,200/month for up to €200,000 billing volume, saves 14%. USD price not published by Stripe.

plans.name: Monthly subscription — Tier 3
plans.notes: Annual contract, paid monthly. EUR page: €2,350/month for up to €400,000 billing volume, saves 16%. USD price not published by Stripe.

plans.name: Monthly subscription — Tier 4
plans.notes: Annual contract, paid monthly. EUR page: €4,900/month for up to €850,000 billing volume, saves 18%. USD price not published by Stripe.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. For high-volume businesses and unique business models. Contact sales.

vendors.name: Paddle
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.paddle.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Pay-as-you-go at 5% + $0.50 per transaction confirmed. Custom enterprise tier confirmed quote-only. Paddle is a merchant of record; no separate monthly platform fee on self-serve tier.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.notes: 5% + $0.50 per checkout transaction. No monthly fee, no migration fee, no hidden extras. Paddle acts as merchant of record — handles global payments, cross-border sales tax, fraud, and chargeback protection.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Quote-only. For rapidly scaling and enterprise businesses. Includes custom rates, success management, custom migration and implementation services, optional premium add-ons.

vendors.name: Maxio
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.maxio.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14 (renders Grow as '$599/month'). GetApp (https://www.getapp.com/finance-management-software/a/maxio/pricing/) and Capterra (https://www.capterra.com/p/139751/Maxio/pricing/) both list Grow as '$599 / Per year'. Frequency conflict is unresolved from public sources; Grow monthlyUsd recorded as null.

plans.name: Build
plans.notes: Free developer sandbox with limited access. Intended for testing billing, pricing, and integrations before going live.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Published figure is $599, but sources conflict on billing frequency: maxio.com/pricing renders '$599/month' (for up to $100K monthly billings), while GetApp and Capterra both list it as '$599 / Per year'. The per-month vs per-year ambiguity cannot be resolved from public sources, so monthlyUsd is set to null rather than asserting a contested or derived figure. Covers up to $100K in monthly billings. Includes recurring billing, usage-based pricing, contract management, revenue recognition, financial reports, CRM/payment integrations, EU and NA support. Unlimited users.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Quote-only. For businesses with >$100K monthly billings. Adds advanced revenue recognition, A/R management, expense amortization, multi-entity support, metering and rating. Volume discounts available.

vendors.name: Zuora
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://zuora.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. No tiers or prices published — fully sales-driven. All plans are quote-only.

plans.name: Zuora Billing
plans.notes: Quote-only. Zuora does not publish pricing. Enterprise subscription and usage-based billing platform. Contact sales via 'Speak to an expert'.

vendors.name: Billsby
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.billsby.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Core=$45/month and Pro=$135/month confirmed. GetApp listed $35 for Core — treated as stale; official site is authoritative.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited setup and testing before going live. Unlimited users.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: $45/month billed monthly, plus 0.4% on revenue exceeding $15,000/month. Up to 5 users. Includes metered billing, pro-rated options, custom fields, automated dunning, QuickBooks integration.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $135/month billed monthly, plus 0.5% on revenue exceeding $30,000/month. Up to 25 users. Adds multiple payment gateways, ACH, multiple tax regions, FreeAgent/TaxJar integrations, advanced reporting, multi-language, full API access.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Quote-only. Unlimited users. Bespoke solution.

vendors.name: Zoho Billing
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.zoho.com/us/subscriptions/pricing.html fetched 2026-06-14. Standard $50/month (monthly) / $39/month (annual) confirmed. Premium $100/month (monthly) / $79/month (annual) confirmed.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $50/month billed monthly; $39/month billed annually (22% discount). Up to 3 users. Quote and invoice creation, multi-currency, custom templates, tax reporting, progress invoicing, self-service customer portal.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $100/month billed monthly; $79/month billed annually (21% discount). Up to 10 users. Adds subscription billing, hosted payment pages, usage-based pricing automation, proration, dunning management, advanced analytics. Excludes local taxes.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. High-volume transactions, advanced usage-based billing, revenue recognition, forecasting, priority support.
